title: Risk Aware Benchmarking of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on general socio-technical risks like drifting from instructions and outputting toxic content.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
